text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's Espoir City! ...Hey, you bastards! 
You know what time it is, right?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm stronger than anyone else. I'm gonna 
show everyone... that I'm one crazy horse 
girl nobody can beat!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Listen here! Don't you dare underestimate 
me! Huuuh?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
